techniques.evidence: crates/engine/src/invocation/tools.rs:16 Classifies Bash command prefixes like git log and find as read-only tools, admitting script execution inside the analyzed repository rather than enforcing static parsing or approved digest checks.
crates/engine/src/invocation/posture.rs:64 Configures CLI flags for subprocess execution rather than platform capability manifests.
crates/engine/src/sandbox/docker.rs:123 Checks image digest pinning to classify execution determinism rather than scoping package manager install verification stages.
crates/engine/src/sandbox/docker.rs:64 Candidate code is streamed into the container over stdin; no archive unpacking occurs.

crates/engine/src/invocation/posture.rs:198 Child environment key stripping protects runtime credentials rather than performing commit-time git secret scanning.

pairs.registryProposal: Clarify in reading-is-not-running that LLM CLI execution runners declaring read-only posture over an untrusted workspace must explicitly enforce isolation flags (e.g. --bare, --ignore-rules) to prevent ambient workspace hooks and skills from executing.
